title: Surreal Alien Over Landscape
description: A large translucent alien with elongated neck and big dark eyes dominates the center, its head merged with a smaller green alien profile featuring a spiral third eye. Below is a pastoral countryside with houses, trees and mist, while the sky blends starry space, purple clouds, a ringed planet, UFO, and dripping pink liquid from the top.
prompt: Surreal cosmic painting featuring a giant translucent alien with long neck and large purple eyes merging with a smaller green alien head that has a spiral third eye. The alien's body dissolves into a peaceful rural landscape with houses, trees and mist at the bottom. Dramatic sky transitions from purple clouds to starry space with a ringed planet, UFO, and dripping magenta liquid from the top edge, vibrant colors, ethereal atmosphere.
